description: This file defines a Drupal plugin class 'FilterCaption' that provides a filter to add captions to images and other elements using the 'data-caption' attribute. It processes HTML content to insert captions, sanitize input, and integrate with Drupal's rendering system.

classes.name: FilterCaption
classes.description: A Drupal plugin class that filters HTML content to add captions to elements with 'data-caption' attributes.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the filter manager, optionally via dependency injection.

methods.name: process
methods.description: Processes the input HTML text to find elements with 'data-caption', sanitize and insert captions, and update the DOM accordingly.

methods.name: tips
methods.description: Provides usage tips for the caption filter, with a long and short version.
